name: Primal Apes
summary:
Primal Apes is an exhilarating indoor game inspired by the popular Gorilla Tag, offering a dynamic and immersive experience within a state-of-the-art facility

In summary, Primal Apes offers a fun and engaging gaming experience inspired by Gorilla Tag, with a variety of game modes, including horror-themed challenges, and a lively player community, all set within an innovative indoor facility. Jump in now to explore the thrilling world of Primal Apes and see what adventures await!
